name: Adobe Firefly
priceBand: Free tier; Standard — check official pricing
bestFor: Designers who must stay inside Photoshop, Illustrator, and a commercial license story
skipIf: You want the wildest aesthetic and do not own Adobe already
keyFeatures: Generative Fill directly on Photoshop & Illustrator layers
limitations: Credit limits deplete fast on heavy campaigns
summary: The safe commercial image tool for teams that already pay Adobe. Less swagger than Midjourney, better paperwork.
body: Firefly’s product is not a pretty Discord. It is generative fill that lands on a layered PSD, with Adobe’s training-data claims attached. Agencies pick it to survive brand legal. Hobbyists who do not have Creative Cloud should not start here. Credit bundles hide inside CC plans, so “Firefly is free” is usually a lie. Check Adobe’s official pricing page for current plan credit rules.
notes: Count credits before a campaign week
Compare with Midjourney on style, not on a single prompt
Pairs with Express for non-designers in the same company
